forest_local.name: forest_local
forest_local.description: Fraction of a 200 m disc around the edge that's forest.

forest_wide.name: forest_wide
forest_wide.description: Fraction of a 2 km disc around the edge that's forest.

local_relief.name: local_relief
local_relief.description: Std-dev of elevation in 500 m window (meters of terrain variation — high in gorges and on mountainsides).

regional_relief.name: regional_relief
regional_relief.description: Std-dev of elevation in 10 km window — regional mountainous-ness, even where local terrain is flat.

distance_to_drama.name: distance_to_drama
distance_to_drama.description: Meters to nearest cell with local_relief ≥ 80 m. Small = visible mountains nearby. ~0 inside dramatic terrain.

view_dominance.name: view_dominance
view_dominance.description: DEM elevation minus 2 km Gaussian blur — meters above local mean.

water_local.name: water_local
water_local.description: Fraction of a 200 m disc around the edge that's lake / pond / wide-river polygon.

water_wide.name: water_wide
water_wide.description: Fraction of a 2 km disc around the edge that's lake / pond / wide-river. Water-rich landscape.

sea_local.name: sea_local
sea_local.description: Fraction of a 200 m disc around the edge that's ocean / sea (pre-built coastline polygons).

sea_wide.name: sea_wide
sea_wide.description: Fraction of a 2 km disc around the edge that's ocean / sea — coastal proximity.

waterway_along_edge.name: waterway_along_edge
waterway_along_edge.description: Fraction of the edge centerline that runs inside a 10 m-buffered river/canal/stream polygon.

waterway_local.name: waterway_local
waterway_local.description: Fraction of a 200 m disc that contains buffered river/canal/stream polygons — waterway proximity.

wetland_local.name: wetland_local
wetland_local.description: Fraction of a 200 m disc that's wetland (marsh, reedbed, bog, saltmarsh, etc.).
